title: OpenDiffraction: Synthetic CDI Patterns
subtitle: Physics-based coherent diffraction images with ground truth and benchmarks
description:
# OpenDiffraction: Physics-Based Synthetic Coherent Diffraction Imaging Dataset

OpenDiffraction is a rigorous, open-access, physics-based synthetic dataset for coherent diffraction imaging (CDI), phase retrieval, and scientific machine learning.

- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/KindlyGentleman/opendiffraction
- **Reference Paper**: Lee et al. (2025), *Deep-learning real-time phase retrieval of imperfect diffraction patterns from X-ray free-electron lasers*, npj Computational Materials 11, 68. DOI: [10.1038/s41524-025-01569-7](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41524-025-01569-7)

---

## Data Provenance & Lineage

- **Origin**: Synthetically generated using the OpenDiffraction Python engine (v2.0.0).
- **Physical Forward Models**: Implements Fraunhofer far-field propagation (F1), corrected Gaussian Schell-model partial coherence (F2), thin-specimen probe transmission (F3), Fresnel near-field propagation (F4), polychromatic spectrum integration (F5), and Bragg nanocrystal diffraction (F6).
- **Detector Physics**: Simulates Poisson photon shot noise ($10^3$ to $10^7$ photons), additive Gaussian readout noise ($sigma=0.1$ to $5.0$), multi-geometry beamstops (rectangular, circular, cross), detector tile gaps, dead pixels, and saturation thresholds.
- **Ground Truth**: Real and complex specimen transmission functions across 4 distinct morphological regimes (biological cells/vesicles, crystalline lattice grains, dense porous nanostructures, and smooth geometric shapes).
- **Reproducibility**: 100% deterministic with recorded per-sample random seeds, strict Parseval energy conservation checks, and CXI (HDF5) compliant data formatting.

---

## Dataset Structure

- `metadata.csv`: Master index of all 1,200 diffraction patterns with physical parameters, forward models, hit types, noise levels, and partition splits.
- `opendiffraction_benchmark.cxi`: Gold-standard Coherent X-ray Imaging (CXI) standard file compliant with CXIDB specifications.
- `data/train_000.h5`: Primary training split (720 patterns) containing measured intensities (512x512), binary detector masks (512x512), and ground truth objects (64x64).
- `data/valid_000.h5`: Validation split (108 patterns) for model tuning and early stopping.
- `data/test_000.h5`: In-distribution test split (65 patterns) for benchmark evaluation.
- `data/test_ood_000.h5`: Out-of-distribution stress test split (108 patterns) with extreme photon starvation, heavy occlusions, and severe partial coherence.

---

## 12 Standardized Machine Learning Tasks (T1 – T12)

1. **T1: Phase Retrieval**: Inverse reconstruction of object amplitude and phase from masked diffraction intensity.
2. **T2: Diffraction Pattern Denoising**: Poisson and Gaussian noise removal in reciprocal space.
3. **T3: Detector Inpainting**: Reconstruction of central beamstop and detector gap pixels.
4. **T4: Hit Finding & Classification**: Classifying single-hit, multi-hit, background, and dark detector frames.
5. **T5: Detector Defect Segmentation**: Pixel-level binary segmentation of dead and saturated pixels.
6. **T6: Specimen Morphology Classification**: Multi-class classification of specimen structural families.
7. **T7: Physical Parameter Estimation**: Regressing incident photon budget and spatial coherence length.
8. **T8: Out-of-Distribution Anomaly Detection**: Identifying out-of-domain patterns and unexpected physical regimes.
9. **T9: Domain Generalization**: Model transfer from idealized Fraunhofer to realistic partial coherence.
10. **T10: Self-Supervised Representation Learning**: Foundation models for diffraction pattern representations.
11. **T11: Uncertainty Quantification**: Pixel-wise predictive variance and confidence calibration.
12. **T12: Forward-Inverse Physics Consistency**: Verifying physical consistency via reciprocal-space reprojection ($R$-factor).

resources.description: Master tabular index of all synthetic diffraction patterns containing physical parameters, forward models, hit types, noise statistics, and split assignments.

fields.name: source_object_id
fields.description: Identifier of the underlying ground-truth specimen morphology.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Variation group identifier grouping related parameter sweeps.

fields.name: split
fields.description: Dataset partition split: train, valid, test, or test_ood.

fields.name: variation_family
fields.description: Variation family code (V01 through V30) designating parameter configuration.

fields.name: object_family
fields.description: Morphological category of specimen (Real-World Specimens, Illumination and Coherence, Detectors and Noise, etc.).

fields.name: density_type
fields.description: Forward simulation optical model: F1 (Fraunhofer), F2 (Partial Coherence), F3 (Thin Object Probe), F4 (Fresnel), F5 (Polychromatic), F6 (Bragg Nanocrystal).

fields.name: photon_budget
fields.description: Total incident photon count before detector Poisson shot noise sampling.

fields.name: coherence_length
fields.description: Spatial coherence length parameter in detector pixel units.

fields.name: readout_noise_std
fields.description: Standard deviation of additive Gaussian electronic detector readout noise.

fields.name: beam_stop_geometry
fields.description: Geometry of central direct-beam blocker mask (e.g., 16x16 square, circular, cross).

fields.name: missing_pixel_fraction
fields.description: Fraction of detector pixels missing due to beamstop, module gaps, and defect mask.

fields.name: detector_saturation_threshold
fields.description: Maximum photon count capacity before detector well saturation (None if unsaturated).

fields.name: beam_center_offset
fields.description: Subpixel coordinate shift (dx, dy) of the incident beam center relative to detector origin.

fields.name: random_seed
fields.description: Deterministic pseudo-random generator seed for exact numerical reproducibility.

fields.name: shard_name
fields.description: Name of the target HDF5 container shard containing array data (e.g., train_000.h5).

fields.name: row_index
fields.description: Zero-based row index within the HDF5 shard container.

fields.name: model_compatibility
fields.description: Downstream benchmark model target compatibility label (e.g., DPR_and_Standard_CDI).
